card.name: Words before a duration or amount threshold
card.fires_on: The word just before a comparison such as 'longer than', 'less than', 'at least' or 'up to'. It is usually a noun or verb like last, doses, durations, periods, exposures or mass, in dosing and animal-study text.

modes.label: Duration before comparison
modes.description: A word about time or length that is followed by a longer/less-than limit.
modes.example: or 400 units per kilogram for those estimated to<< last>> longer than 60 minutes.

modes.label: Doses or exposures before a limit
modes.description: A dose or exposure noun followed by a higher/up-to amount.
modes.example: Rats, however, tolerated single oral<< doses>> of up to 3 g/kg.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that state a threshold or excess, such as 'excess' and 'up', and away from words about variation.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before a text states a limit like 'longer than 60 minutes' or 'up to 3 g/kg'.
